items.name: mask-hover
items.title: Mask Hover
items.description: Interactive mask hover. Spotlight follows cursor; customizable text, colors, mask size. Includes MousePointer hook and mask.svg.

items.name: expandable-cards
items.title: Expandable Cards
items.description: A fully reusable expandable cards component with modal detail view. Features smooth layout animations, customizable card styling, optional tags/badges, configurable detail sections (attributes and stats with progress bars), and flexible grid layouts. Works with any data type via generic props.

items.name: text-stagger
items.title: Text Stagger
items.description: A text stagger component that animates the text as it is hovered over. It is a reusable component that can be used to animate any text.
